description: First live checks required after the ds4_on_spark v2 substrate lands.

tasks.purpose: Prove --runner vllm works against each resident Qwen lane with both static Qwen profiles loaded.
tasks.command_template: ssh {node} 'cd {repo}/v2 && DS4_VLLM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_infer.cli submit --profiles-dir profiles/models --requests {requests_jsonl} --out {out_dir}/{node}-qwen-vllm --runner vllm --runner-timeout-s 600 --run'
acceptance: all target nodes return completed_count=2
each result status is completed
selected profiles include both Qwen profile ids
capture /v1/models and runner output
spark6 is included as the fifth Qwen production lane

tasks.purpose: Prove --runner vllm works against the grouped spark4+spark5 DSV4 vLLM/MTP lane.
tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && DS4_VLLM_MTP_BASE_URL=http://spark4:8000 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_infer.cli submit --profiles-dir profiles/models --topology profiles/topology/static_sparks.json --requests {requests_jsonl} --out {out_dir}/spark45-dsv4-vllm-mtp --runner vllm --runner-timeout-s 1200 --run
acceptance: request using capability=smartest and chat=true completes
selected node is spark4+spark5
transport base_url is the MTP endpoint
record prompt/completion token usage when endpoint returns it

tasks.purpose: Prove --runner vllm works against spark6 after converting it from antirez/support into the fifth resident Qwen lane.
tasks.command_template: ssh spark6 'cd {repo}/v2 && DS4_VLLM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_infer.cli submit --profiles-dir profiles/models --requests {requests_jsonl} --out {out_dir}/spark6-qwen-vllm --runner vllm --runner-timeout-s 600 --run'
acceptance: completed_count=2
selected profiles include both Qwen profile ids
response records are non-empty
capture /v1/models and runner output

tasks.purpose: Prove ds4-spark-chat works from Mac Studio against the resident DSV4 vLLM/MTP lane.
tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && DS4_VLLM_MTP_BASE_URL=http://spark4:8000 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_chat.cli --registry tools/registry.jsonl --history {out_dir}/mac-studio-chat-history.json --timeout-s 1200 --max-tokens 512 --ask 'Answer with one sentence: what are the three static DS4 v2 inference lanes?'
acceptance: command exits 0
assistant response is non-empty
history file is written
no tool action is claimed without a tool result

tasks.purpose: Install Playwright only if rendered web access is required, then prove tool:web.fetch rendered mode works.
tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && python3 -m pip install '.[web]' && python3 -m playwright install chromium && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_tools.cli invoke --registry tools/registry.jsonl --tool-id tool:web.fetch --arguments '{"url":"https://example.com","mode":"rendered","max_text_chars":1000}'
acceptance: install succeeds when rendered access is needed
tool:web.fetch returns ok=true
mode is rendered
fallback text mode remains available without Playwright

tasks.purpose: Prove the normal DSV4 vLLM profile can be launched with LMCache and reuse a warmed shared_prefix without adding a second DSV4 instance.
tasks.command_template: cd {repo}/v2 && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m ds4_kvcache.cli write-scripts --deployment profiles/kv_cache/dsv4_spark45_lmcache.json --output-dir /tmp/ds4_lmcache_dsv4 && /tmp/ds4_lmcache_dsv4/00_install_kv_cache_deps.sh && echo 'start /tmp/ds4_lmcache_dsv4/start_vllm_cache.sh under the Spark vLLM service supervisor before running queue-warm-prefixes'
acceptance: LMCache imports in the vLLM runtime
one DSV4 vLLM server owns both KV load and save
queue-warm-prefixes records a completed warm for a long shared_prefix
second same-prefix request has materially lower TTFT/prefill time than cold
no prefiller/decoder/proxy split is started
